title: SaveFile.es3
description: Easy Save 3 serialisation of the TVS game save file. Each top-level key is a save key; each value is an ES3-typed wrapper object. Only keys relevant to TVSSave.Tools are explicitly typed here; all others are treated as opaque passthrough.

SavedPresetNames.description: Sparse list of player-created character names indexed by in-game slot number. Null entries indicate empty slots.

__type.description: C# fully-qualified type name as written by Easy Save 3.

value.description: Slot-indexed array of character names. Index N corresponds to presetSlotN.txt.tmp.

additionalProperties.description: All other save keys are opaque ES3-typed wrapper objects and must pass through unmodified.
